children: Overview
US premium entertainment firm's Q3 revenue and OTT revenue grew both sequentially and yr/yr
Adjusted OIBDA for Q3 more than doubled yr/yr, despite an operating loss
Company reaffirmed all 2026 financial targets, including OIBDA and free cash flow
Outlook
Company reiterates outlook for positive year-over-year OTT revenue growth in 2026
Company maintains 2026 Adjusted OIBDA outlook of mid-single-digit percentage growth
Company reaffirms 2026 Unlevered Free Cash Flow outlook of $100 mln to $120 mln
Result Drivers
PROGRAMMING PORTFOLIO - Co said its portfolio approach to programming is driving a more durable revenue base
CONTENT COST STRUCTURE - Co undertook actions to rationalize its content portfolio and right-size content cost structure in response to industry changes
